instruction: Search for Team Fortress 2 and add the soundtrack DLC to your cart.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding Team Fortress 2 in Steam store and adding soundtrack DLC to cart. Uses existing is_added_to_steam_cart metric to verify cart content. Similar complexity to original Dota 2 task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the final state: checks if 'Team Fortress 2 Soundtrack' is present in Steam cart page content
Getter logic is appropriate: navigates to cart URL and fetches page content including HTML
Metric logic is semantically correct: uses is_added_to_steam_cart to check for item presence in cart
Expected value is correct: 'Team Fortress 2 Soundtrack' matches the soundtrack DLC requirement
Complete coverage of final requirement: verifies that the soundtrack DLC was added to cart
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: String matching approach is fragile: metric uses simple 'item not in content' check on raw HTML. Consider using HTML parsing (BeautifulSoup) to extract cart item names more reliably
No verification of intermediate search step: evaluator only checks final cart state, doesn't verify that user actually searched for Team Fortress 2
Product name variations not handled: if Steam displays the product name with different formatting, spacing, or HTML entities, the string match may fail
Consider adding fuzzy matching or partial string matching to handle minor variations in product name display
